purpose: Five independent Mihomo Console app-icon concepts for review; not automatically installed as the favicon.

concepts.name: 01-switchboard
concepts.title: Switchboard
concepts.prompt: Use case: logo-brand. Create a single original app icon for Mihomo Console, a NAS proxy subscription manager. Square opaque full-bleed raster master, 1024 by 1024 if available, no rounded outer corners and no external presentation frame. Direction: a confident flat screenprinted switchboard mark, three broad ivory paths enter from the lower-left and bend cleanly to merge at one large offset circular junction near upper-right, with one short outgoing path. The whole connected mark has a strong compact angular silhouette, three clear parallel negative-space channels, equal thick strokes and softly squared terminals. Asymmetric diagonal composition, visually balanced and occupying about 70 percent of the square. Deep cobalt blue ink field, warm ivory mark, one restrained orange junction accent. Authored Swiss utility graphic, precise opaque local color, subtle ink edge character only; no 3D, no gloss, no gradients, no glow, no tiny traces or decorative nodes. Recognition must survive at 32px. One fused symbol, no letters, no text, no watermark, no mockup. This is an independent concept; do not reference previous images.

concepts.name: 02-paper-sync
concepts.title: Paper Sync
concepts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create one original square app icon for Mihomo Console, managing and refreshing subscription configurations. Opaque full-bleed square raster artwork, 1024 by 1024 if available, no outer rounded mask or presentation border. Direction Paper Sync: one tightly fused sculptural stack of two broad folded document sheets. The foremost sheet curls at its upper-right edge into a large returning fold suggesting renewal; the return fold is part of the paper construction, not a printed refresh symbol. Bold compact silhouette, two overlapping planes and one unmistakable broad curled corner, no text lines and no tiny details. Slight diagonal top-down view with the object leaning toward upper-left, comfortable margins. Sage green heavyweight paper upper sheet, deep forest green second layer, exposed warm white paper edges. Warm off-white handmade paper field formed by a subtle large pressure-imprint under the object. Tactile cut-paper/origami fabrication with crisp folds, diffuse daylight and shallow honest contact shadows. Quiet, crafted and practical; avoid glossy plastic, cartoon bubbles, neon, glass, gradients, extra stationery props and text. Readable at 32px. Independent artwork; no connection to any previous image.

concepts.name: 03-token-gate
concepts.title: Token Gate
concepts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Original app-icon artwork for Mihomo Console, a token-protected NAS management panel. One opaque full-bleed square raster master, 1024 by 1024 if available; no exterior rounded corners or device mockup. Direction Token Gate: a single sturdy arch-shaped gateway milled from copper and graphite, as a symbolic route that opens under authorized control. Dominant silhouette is a thick inverted-U arch with two squared feet and generous rectangular dark negative space; one small rectangular amber latch is integrated at the inner right edge. No literal key, no separate shield, no lock badge and no scenery. Straight-on, symmetrical architectural composition with the latch supplying a subtle asymmetry, occupying 72 percent of the image. Visible real machining planes and restrained brushed-copper edges, inset graphite arch faces, diffuse neutral lighting and a broad soft cast shadow. A full-bleed dark charcoal field with a faint wide stamped recess shaped by the gate, not ambient light effects. Precise industrial, dependable, handsome restrained material rendering. Strong value separation at 32px; keep only three broad construction planes. No text, logos, watermark, glowing circuitry, glass, spectral gradients or neon atmosphere. Independent concept.

concepts.name: 04-console-cat
concepts.title: Console Cat
concepts.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Design one original app icon for Mihomo Console, a friendly proxy/subscription controller. Square opaque full-bleed raster master, 1024 by 1024 if available, no rounded external tile mask or mockup. Direction Console Cat: a distinctive compact cat HEAD only with broad triangular ears, a slightly off-center curious expression, one dark rounded eye and one simple closed-eye curve, a little triangular nose. Two broad angular cheek strokes subtly suggest paired routing chevrons while still reading as natural cheek markings. The head is one dominant silhouette with no body, paws, props, badges or background scenery. Editorial linocut and spot-color illustration: bold warm vermilion silhouette, near-black hand-cut facial marks, a small cream muzzle negative space. Golden pale ochre paper field with a very subtle print-pressure impression; crisp well-authored irregular carved edges, not furry detail. Head fills roughly 75 percent of square and is optically balanced despite the asymmetrical expression. Cheerful but capable, graphic rather than toy-like; broad simple anatomy and high contrast survive 32px. No lettering, no copied mascot, no watermark, no 3D, glossy surfaces or gradients. Fully independent artwork.

concepts.name: 05-mc-relay
concepts.title: MC Relay
concepts.prompt: Use case: logo-brand. Create one original app-icon raster master for Mihomo Console. Square opaque full-bleed artwork, 1024 by 1024 if available, no rounded exterior corners or external preview frame. Direction MC Relay: purpose-designed bold MC monogram, the exact only lettering is MC, fused into one strong industrial stencil mark. A compact geometric M sits within the generous open counter of a thick C which sweeps around three sides; one open right-side gap makes the C a clear pathway. Broad strokes, substantial angular M peaks, purposeful stencil bridges and negative space; MC must remain readable rather than looking like unrelated menu glyphs. Off-center poster-like composition with the monogram slightly toward upper-left and a single wide underlying alignment band extending to the right edge. Opaque near-black mark on an acid yellow/green field with one near-black broad right-edge band; no additional accents. Crisp flat utility signage, authored typographic negative-space construction, slight screenprint ink bite at large size only. Distinctive severe, energetic and practical aesthetic. Strong silhouette legibility at 32px, no fine circuits, no gradients, no dimensional gloss, no border, no captions, no watermark or trademark imitation. An independent concept, unrelated to previous generated images.
